notes.title: Another New Update has Arrived!
notes.content:
[h1]The awesome witches has casted some amazing spells to the world of Furriend.
[/h1]

Now, you can enjoy the game even more with all of the updates we have made in the game, here're all of those updates.

[h3]Casted Spells (Change Log):
[list]
[*]Add encouragement words when progress reach 50%
[*]Add level complete screen when player complete the level
[*]Add Simplified Chinese & Traditional Chinese Localization
[*]Fixing all of the bugs we've discovered
[*]Update achievement icon
[/list][/h3]

So, come to the world full of magic once more and play with all of the witches and their beloved pawsome furriend.

[h3]Complete all of the pawzzle rituals again and summon even more pawsome companion, Furriend![/h3]

notes.title: Full Story is Finally Here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023029/76c62f558791119d3a0465e7bb82aee501bc51b6.png[/img]

[h1]Explore The Long Awaited Full Story of The Witches and Their Furriends![/h1]

[h2]The long awaited full story of Furrina the Witch is finally here![/h2]

Explore and follow all of the story of Furrina the Witch with her Cat Furriend in search of true and gleeful friendship.

Enjoy the story as you progress and finish through all of the pawzzles where Furrina along with her Cat Furriend will meet many other witches and their furriends along the journey, who also wish to be able to overcome their lonesome life by summoning furriends, the pawsome companion, to accompany their days. You can enjoy the full story of Furrina and other witches in the [b]Furriend - Story Mode DLC[/b].

[h2]Full list of updates summoned into the game's Steam build version 1.1.0 together with the full story are:[/h2]

- Add new story for each chapter
- Add Keyboard & Controller support
- Add localization for Indonesia & Japan language
- Add interactive tutorial
- Add credit screen (unlocked after completing the game)
- Lots of bug fixing

Furrina and all of the witches can't wait to meet you all on their journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45023029/d7766bd3918882fa06282a5388700f085023e209.png[/img]
